page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with printed line numbers (5, 10, 15 and so on) in the left margin. Below the text: the signature "Dd" and the catchword "vt bene-". The left edge carries fragments of the facing page, and show-through appears in the text. Neither is transcribed.

main_text.p: ad mortem, & commoda in morte constitutio. Legitima praeparatio ad mortem est vniuersalis & particularis. Vniuersalis est, qua quis toto vitae suae curriculo ad moriendum se accingit. Consistit haec praeparatio in tribus hisce partibus. Primo requiritur mortis in vita meditatio, exemplo 5Christi. Matth. 16. v. 21. Confer Psal. 39. v. 5. & 90. v. 12. Oportet autem mortem intueri primo vt poenam peccati Gen. 1. & 2. deinde vt transitum ex hac vita in vitam aeternam Eccles. 7. v. 1. Luc. 23. v. 43. Secundo requiritur praxis & 10instauratio quotidiana poenitentiae, consistens in mortificatione veteris & noui hominis. Ita enim fit, vt vim roburque mortis, id est, peccatum, quotidie infringamus 1. Corin. 15. v. 56. & ad primum vitae aeternae gradum in hac vita accedamus Luc. 17. v. 21. Gal. 2. v. 20, & indies moriamur, 15ne in aeternum moriamur. 1. Cor. 15. v. 31. Pertinet huc illud elegantissimum Germanorum: Wer da stirbt, ehe er stirbt, der stirbt nicht wann er stirbt. Neque enim male mori potest, qui bene vixit. Ita videmus Christi sanctam vitam praecessisse & peperisse mortem gloriosam. Tertio oportet 20res nostras tempestiue constituere. Eccles. 9. v. 10. Gal. 6. v. 10. Sic videmus Christum fideliter fecisse officium suum praedicando hinc inde euangelium, antequam pateretur, Praeparatio particularis, siue specialis est, quae fit infirma valetudine appetente: vbi officium aegri est triplex. Primum 25est erga Deum; operam videl dare reconciliationi sui ipsius cum Deo in Christo per renouationem fidei & resipiscentiae, adeoque confessionem peccati. Psalm. 6. & 38. Secundum est erga seipsum: vbi aeger curabit animam & corpus. Et animam quidem ita, vt non tam mortem, quam beneficia Dei post mortem intueatur; vt mortem contempletur non in speculo legis, sed euangelii; denique vt meditetur prouidentiam Dei, eiusque promissiones, 30ministerium sanctorum angelorum &c. Corpus vero hac ratione, vt omnem valetudini & vitae tuendae atque conseruandae det operam, tantisper, dum prorsus a Deo tollatur. 2. Reg. 10. v. 7. Luc. 10. v. 34. Sic autem vtatur medicina, 35vt benef[?]

page.notes: The line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed in the left margin; they are placed beside their lines as notes. The paragraph has no clear indent, so it is kept as one paragraph. The first paragraph is marked cont="true" because it begins mid-sentence. The last word of the page is cut off at the foot; the text after "vt benef" is covered by the catchword, so the final word "beneficio" is uncertain and should be checked. The overlay "Vivificatione" in the middle of line 8 is show-through from the other side and is excluded. Long s has been normalised to plain s, including in the German line, where the printed black letter reads "ftirbt" and "ftirbt". The Latin "Ita enim fit" and similar spellings are kept as printed.
